directory_policies.notes.4: GPA policy: Desirable minimum 3.0/4; competitiveness and calculation scope require review. No universal hard cutoff is asserted.
directory_policies.notes.5: English policy: The department lists legacy TOEFL 100, new TOEFL 5.0 or IELTS 7.5 with specified subscores. Test validity and exemption rules still need complete review.

source_excerpt: A GRE score is not required
fact_summary: Current on-campus MSCS instructions make GRE optional and distinguish desired GPA from program-specific language thresholds.
